aardeyamz.title: Yannis Lam
aardeyamz.pronounciation: /y æ - n ih s · l a m/
content: my parents' gift to me in English
Yannis (Γιάννης) - Greek name meaning "God is gracious" or "with God's grace"; commonly translated to "John"
Lam (林) - Common British Hong Kong romanization of Chinese surname meaning "forest"

aardeyamz.title: 林恩力
content: what my parents decided to name me in Chinese
林 - Common Chinese surname meaning "forest"; romanized to "Lam" or "Lin"
恩 - Chinese character meaning "grace"; common Chinese name for girls with the English name of "Grace"

list.title: Analysis of Salary Factors in Massachusetts
description: Investigated the wage gap between remote and in-person employment during the COVID-19 recession. While pandemic conditions amplified these differentials, analysis showed structural wage disparities predated the pandemic across geography, industry, occupation, and work history.

Built predictive models using linear, lasso, and ridge regression to analyze salary determination in Massachusetts. Examined causal relationships between demographic/employment variables and hourly wages, providing insights into occupational earnings potential within the Commonwealth.

list.title: DBTBT.com
description: In CS 326: Web Programming, partnered with Christian Daher, Bhogesh Maddirala, and Matthew Lehoullier to build a platform encouraging smarter financial decision-making. The application compares Amazon products with similarly-priced stock investment alternatives, helping users redirect impulse spending toward long-term wealth building.

Tech stack: Node.js (backend & socket server), React (frontend), Apache & Nginx (reverse proxies), Amazon EC2 & GCP Compute Engine (hosting), Amazon RDS with MySQL (database), Amazon Route 53 (DNS). Deployed live at https://www.dbtbt.com/

list.title: Raspberry Pi Python Timelapse Controller
description: Built an automated timelapse photography system with Henry Cheung, Veronica Gusev, and Nhan Le. A Python script on the Raspberry Pi controlled a DSLR camera at configurable intervals, capturing images that were automatically compiled and encoded into timelapse videos.

list.title: Arduino Smart Window
description: Built an automated window shade system with Jeffrey Carr for CICS 290M: Physical Computing. An Arduino microcontroller monitored ambient light levels via a photoresistor and automatically adjusted a servo-controlled shade to optimize natural lighting in real-time.

list.title: ZebRed PC Build
description: Custom-built high-performance desktop workstation optimized for development and creative work. Engineered component selection for performance, thermal efficiency, and long-term value. Continuously refined and upgraded over 8+ years of active use and iteration.

list.title: Arduino Security System
description: Built an ultrasonic proximity-based alarm system with Jeffrey Carr, Henry Cheung, and Steven Yen. An Arduino microcontroller monitored distance via ultrasonic sensor and provided visual feedback through a NeoPixel ring that intensified as objects approached, turning red when triggering the alarm threshold.

list.title: Queen of the Desert: Mother of Kings
description: Senior capstone project exploring Gertrude Bell's historical significance and influence on modern Middle Eastern geopolitics. Collaborated with Matthew Pugsley, Katie O'Neil, and Laura Wang to research and present at the national competition.

list.title: Scientology: An Exploration into the Unknown
description: Researched the life of L. Ron Hubbard and the origins of the Scientology movement with Matthew Pugsley, Katie O'Neil, and Laura Wang. Our exhibit earned 3rd place at the Massachusetts South Shore regional History Day competition.

list.title: Finding MH370: Satellite Data Analysis
description: Analyzed publicly released satellite data to reconstruct a probable flight path and proposed impact coordinates for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 in the Indian Ocean. Won 1st place at the high school science fair and advanced to regional and state competitions.

list.title: Clouded by Delusion: The Salem Court System
description: Examined the institutional failures and legal flaws that precipitated the Salem Witch Trials. Collaborated with Lily Tang, Matthew Pugsley, Amanda Ramos, and Caitlin Leach to research and exhibit findings, earning 1st place at South Shore Regional competition and Honorable Mention at state level.
